trust_decision.summary: Whether an unscoped secret (--key / WLC_KEY) may be paired with an API URL supplied by an auto-discovered, repository-controlled project config file; decided (not at all at the pinned commit) in WeblateConfig.get_url_key, which picks URL and key independently with no notion of where the URL came from.

landing_point.why: get_url_key is the single place where URL and key are combined; the summary ('disclose API tokens to project-configured URLs') leads straight there.

fix_sites.entry_point: WeblateConfig.load() (CLI default discovery; public library API)
fix_sites.module_kind: config_loader (records URL source per file via new _read_config, fix.diff:366-394)

fix_sites.entry_point: WeblateConfig.get_url_key() (public API; called by Weblate(config=...) at wlc/client.py:63 and by main's denied-key handler at wlc/main.py:972)
wlc CLI, every subcommand via parse_settings
fix_sites.module_kind: CLI wrapper (early validate_url_key so error is reported at config time, fix.diff:476)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: wlc/config.py:82-94 — the loader (file-read step) must record which file supplied [weblate] url; the check in get_url_key never sees file provenance at the pinned commit because RawConfigParser.read merges files into one namespace

O3_reason_to_dismiss: README documents the exact vulnerable combination as the intended CI workflow (repo provides project config, WLC_KEY injected as secret, README.md:75-77) and an existing test asserts it works (tests/test_config.py:251), so a solver can argue env/CLI keys with project URLs are a supported feature, or fix only WLC_KEY and leave --key (or vice versa).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Must keep working: URL-scoped [keys] entries with a project-config URL; WLC_KEY with an explicit --config file URL; WLC_KEY/--key with a user (XDG) config URL; WLC_KEY with WLC_URL / --key with --url while a project config exists. An over-broad fix (reject any env/CLI key whenever a project file exists, or ignore project url) breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: URL from project file .weblate / .weblate.ini / weblate.ini in cwd or any parent
URL from user XDG/APPDATA config or explicit --config (allowed)

O7_producer.where: wlc/config.py:82-94 (load -> self.read merges user and project files)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second settings source (e.g. a WLC_CONFIG env var or a project-local file named in pyproject/setup.cfg) that also merges a URL into the same parser without provenance
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: parse_settings already has two config-ingest branches (load vs programmatic settings), so adding another discovery source is a natural maintainer change

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a Weblate.from_project()/from_env() style factory that reads project config and WLC_KEY itself, bypassing get_url_key
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the constructor already has two independent URL/key paths (config vs explicit args); a convenience wrapper for CI use is plausible

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a per-directory override discovered via find_config (e.g. ./weblate.ini treated as user config on Windows APPDATA-like lookup) that should be classed as project
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: find_config and find_project_config share filenames (weblate.ini), so a misclassified source is an easy parser/provenance differential

O9_family: credential disclosure to untrusted destination (CWE-200/CWE-349: trusting attacker-supplied config merged with trusted secret)

O10_build.toolchain: pip/uv, pytest; deps requests, pyxdg, urllib3
O10_build.project_tests: tests/test_config.py (discovery/precedence, incl. tests/test_config.py:251) and tests/test_main.py TestSettings (CLI config paths, uses a mocked server)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: In get_url_key, ignore WLC_KEY (or refuse any env/CLI key) whenever find_project_config() returns a file — breaks user-config/--config/WLC_URL-pinned cases and misses whether that file actually set the url.

out_of_scope_notes: Server-returned URLs (pagination next, object _url) are already origin-pinned by normalize_request_url (wlc/client.py:119-126) and redirects are refused (wlc/client.py:275-281); not this advisory.
A project config read after the user config can overwrite the user's [keys] entry for the same URL (key substitution, not disclosure).
